verdict.rationale: Mem0 Platform docs explicitly describe automatic construction of a knowledge graph from stored memories, with entities as nodes and shared-entity linking across memories, directly framed around answering entity-centric, multi-hop questions like 'what do we know about Alice?' without needing to provision a separate graph database (mem0-docs-8, -23, -24, -29, -38, -39, -44). This is first-party but detailed and consistent across multiple doc pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification specifically testing multi-hop graph queries (community evidence mostly discusses general fact-storage memory rather than the graph-entity feature specifically, e.g. mem0-comm-9 contrasts Mem0 with pattern-learning systems but doesn't directly test or refute graph-memory multi-hop capability).
